burrata.name: Burrata & agyapadeɛ tomato
burrata.short: Burrata a ɛyɛ krim, tomato a abere, sourdough a wɔayam.
burrata.description: Burrata a wɔayɛ no foforo, agyapade tomato a ɛyɛ dɛ ne basil bɔɔl a ɛyɛ mmerɛw, a wɔde ngodua ngo awie. Fa sourdough a wɔayam a ɛyɛ hyew gu mu.
burrata.ingredients: Burrata (nufusu), tomato, basil, ngodua ngo, sourdough (awi), ɛpo mu nkyene.

dumplings.name: Dumplings a wɔde chili ayɛ a ɛyɛ crisp
dumplings.short: Sika kɔkɔɔ nhabannuru dumplings, chili ngo, scallions.
dumplings.description: Nnuadewa dumplings asia a wɔayam wɔ kyɛnsee mu a ase yɛ crisp na mfinimfini yɛ mmerɛw. Wɔde chili ngo ne scallions awie, na wɔde soya dipping sauce ahyɛ nkyɛn.
dumplings.ingredients: Awi a wɔde kyekyere nneɛma ho, kabege, nsenia, karɔt, scallions, soya sauce (soya, awi), sesame, chili ngo.

pasta.name: Tomato & basil a wɔde yɛ rigatoni
pasta.short: Tomato a wɔayam brɛoo, basil a wɔayɛ no foforo, parmesan.
pasta.description: Pasta a wɔabɔ no akuturuku a wɔde tomato a wɔayam a ɛyɛ dɛ a wɔayam no brɛoo mu, a basil a wɔayɛ no foforo ne parmesan a wɔmfa afifide nni dwuma wom. Awerɛkyekye, ɛnyɛ den, na wɔayɛ ama awia aduan tenten.
pasta.ingredients: Rigatoni (awi), tomato, basil, parmesan a wɔmfa afifide nni dwuma (nufusu), ngodua ngo, galik.

salad.name: Turo mu kuruwa a wɔayam
salad.short: Nnuadewa a wɔayam, chickpeas, citrus & nhabannuru.
salad.description: Beets a wɔayam ne ɛmo a ɛyɛ dɛ wɔ nhaban a ɛyɛ crisp so, a chickpeas, citrus a ɛhyerɛn ne nhabannuru a ɛyɛ foforo ka ho. Lemon dressing ma ne nyinaa bom.
salad.ingredients: Beets, ɛmo a ɛyɛ dɛ, chickpeas, citrus, nhaban momono, parsley, mint, sesame, lemon, ngodua ngo.

chicken.name: Lemon & nhabannuru akokɔ
chicken.short: Sikakɔkɔɔ akokɔ, ɛmo nkokoaa, bankye a ɛyɛ ahabammono.
chicken.description: Akokɔ a wɔde nhabannuru ayɛ a ne honam ani yɛ crisp, ɛmo nkokoaa ne bankye a ɛyɛ ahabammono. Wɔde lemon a emu yɛ hare ne ngodua ngo jus ka ho.
chicken.ingredients: Akokɔ, ɛmo, bankye a ɛyɛ ahabammono, lemon, ngodua ngo, rosemary, thyme, galik.

cake.name: Chocolate ganache keeki a wɔde yɛ keeki
cake.short: Chocolate tuntum, vanilla cream, raspberry a wɔayɛ no foforo.
cake.description: Chocolate layer keeki a ɛyɛ dɛ a wɔde chocolate tuntum ganache a ɛhyerɛn ayɛ. Vanilla cream kakra ne raspberry a wɔayɛ no foforo wɔ nkyɛn.
cake.ingredients: Chocolate, awi esiam, nkesua, bɔta (nufusu), cream (nufusu), asikre, vanilla, raspberry.

lemonade.name: Strawberry basil lemonade a wɔde yɛ aduru
lemonade.short: Strawberry a ɛyɛ foforo, lemon, basil & nsu a ɛyɛ hyew.
lemonade.description: Lemonade a ɛhyerɛn na ɛhyerɛn kakra a wɔde strawberry a wɔayɛ no foforo, lemon a wɔahyɛ no den ne basil a ɛyɛ huam ayɛ. Wɔde ma wɔ nsukyenee so.
lemonade.ingredients: Strawberry, lemon, basil, cane asikre, nsu a ɛyɛ hyew, nsukyenee.

tea.name: Jasmine tii a wɔde ice ayɛ
tea.short: Nhwiren jasmine tii, lemon, nsukyenee pii.
tea.description: Jasmine tii a wɔayɛ no foforo, a wɔayɛ no nwini na wɔde agu nsukyenee a wɔde lemon ayɛ so. Unsweetened, a nhwiren a ɛyɛ brɛoo awie.
tea.ingredients: Jasmine tii, lemon, nsu a wɔayiyi, nsukyenee. Caffeine na ɛwɔ mu.
